name: io.github.A1-x-Tech/mcp-google-sheets
title: Google Sheets MCP
description: MCP server for the Google Sheets API: read and write ranges, sheets, formatting, charts, sharing.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_SHEETS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth2 client secret (refresh-token flow). Treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_SHEETS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth2 refresh token, exchanged for access tokens automatically. Treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Static OAuth2 access token (~1h lifetime) — alternative to the refresh-token trio, mostly for testing.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_SHEETS_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries on transient errors (429 always; 5xx/network for reads).
